correctness.rationale: For 4-site site-disordered boundary-driven exclusion process with tau=(1,4,2,1), tau_r=1 and reservoirs (1+d)/2,(1-d)/2, departure site hop rate 1/(2tau_i), build all 16 binary states and twice-physical-rate Markov generator Q. Stationary distribution solves Q^T p=0 and sum p=1; irreducibility for |d|<1 proves unique stationarity and endpoint rational extension. The source formula J(d)=d N(d)/D(d) was independently checked from fresh exact 16x16 rational stationary equations at d=-99/100,-1/2,0,1/2,99/100,1 (not asserted as a whole-symbolic identity solely from six points); inspected symbolic source algorithm independently constructs and inverts Q for an indeterminate d and asserts exact equality J=dN/D. The antisymmetry E(d)=J(d)+J(-d) simplifies algebraically to 2d^2 P(d^2)/(D(d)D(-d)). D(d)>=252931232>0 on [-1,1]. P(z)=2514276z^4-1658361577z^3+207843423093z^2+15992346284053z-14990744789037 has strictly positive derivative on [0,1], with P(0)<0<P(1); unique d*=sqrt(z*) near 0.96244526, E negative below, positive above. Exact opposite signs E(1/2)<0<E(99/100) persist under small changes in bulk rates by continuity, yielding at least one nearby zero (not uniqueness). Zero-drive Bernoulli equilibrium occupancies (1/2,4/5,2/3,1/2) demonstrate asymmetry. Statement does not falsely assert all biases rectify.
